## System: E - Deep feature discovery sweep (UX/memory, orchestration, codegen, validation/RAG, inference, observability, vision/security/economics, CI/skills, planning/RL)

Family E is a 55-session post-B/C/D improvement sweep. Each E-N is a self-contained implementation prompt with a WIRING_CONTRACT, a relation label (DELTA / EXTENSION / REPLACEMENT), and a plan-recorded status. Deep discovery did not independently verify implementation against the codebase. Where the summary layer and an original plan disagree, original-source / newer-plan precedence sets the target state. Losing descriptions stay as Superseded bullets.

Atom namespace: `E-00N/<local-id>` for deep ledgers; `SUMMARY/E-N.Fxx` for orientation. Status labels are plan-recorded claims unless noted.

Source aggregate (read-only): `docs/thefinalglance/feature-discovery/aggregates/E-AGGREGATE.md`.

  - ClaimWithConfidence has text, tier in Verified|ReadFromSource|FromTraining|Guessed, and optional EvidenceRef. (`E-003/E003-E4-003`)
  - ChatReflectPipeline AUDITOR emits claim wrappers; passed FILE_CHECK/SOURCE_CHECK/TEST_CHECK/WEB_CHECK maps to Verified or ReadFromSource, no grounding maps to FromTraining, and a low-confidence mcp_think status echo maps to Guessed. (`E-003/E003-E4-004`)
  - CommandWindow renders a pill before every factual claim, and E-1 memory_notes can persist the claim as fact_type=claim with confidence_tier and provenance. (`E-003/E003-E4-005`)
  - SycophancyGuard amends the AUDITOR prompt: retain a cited position when evidence contradicts the user, state lack of evidence explicitly, and never agree merely to be agreeable. (`E-003/E003-E4-006`)
  - Pushback is permitted only with Verified-tier evidence; user thanks is not a reward; a skipped pushback opportunity requires no_evidence_for_pushback evidence; the helper coexists with AUDITOR REFINE cap=2. (`E-003/E003-E4-007`)
  - An AUDITOR override of REASONER stance emits sycophancy_pushback_detected and is acceptance-tested with a planted false claim. (`E-003/E003-E4-008`)
  - PinnedRulesPanel.svelte reads rules.db ACTIVE rows plus session ad-hoc constraints and renders them in the CommandWindow sidebar. (`E-003/E003-E4-009`)
  - The panel is collapsed by default, expands on demand, pins via user_rule_pinned, and click-to-remove emits user_rule_unpinned. (`E-003/E003-E4-010`)
  - Session re-anchor runs after N turns, default 10 and configurable, or before commit, force-push, or file-delete. (`E-003/E003-E4-011`)
  - Re-anchor re-injects the system prompt, first user message, and active rules, emits session_re_anchored, exposes cadence in SettingsWindow, and shows a toast. (`E-003/E003-E4-012`)
  - DoomLoopDetector fires on any of four conditions: three same-file edits for one issue, three failed mcp_think hypotheses, two consecutive auditor BLOCKs, or a plateauing test-pass rate. (`E-003/E003-E4-013`)
  - On doom-loop detection the runner freezes, emits doom_loop_detected, and shows attempt diffs plus Switch tactic, Hand back to user, and Continue anyway controls. (`E-003/E003-E4-014`)
  - Doom-loop thresholds are configurable; dismissing the detector emits doom_loop_threshold_adjusted because legitimate refactors may otherwise false-positive. (`E-003/E003-E4-015`)
  - Completion phrases including done, complete, finished, and successfully implemented require at least one file diff, audit-verdict/test row, or deterministic-check pass. (`E-003/E003-E4-016`)
  - CompletionClaimCheck rejects an ungrounded completion in AUDITOR, emits completion_claim_rejected_no_evidence, and renders an evidence-link cluster below an accepted claim. (`E-003/E003-E4-017`)
  - The initial ambiguity heuristic is task length under 50 characters plus missing action verb plus no target file/scope; B-38’s continuous ambiguity score replaces it when shipped. (`E-003/E003-E4-018`)
  - An ambiguous task produces exactly one clarifier card with at most three yes/no questions; after one response it proceeds without another round and emits one_shot_clarifier_emitted/resolved. (`E-003/E003-E4-019`)
  - Default output is action plus one-line why plus one-line risk; /verbose applies long form for the next N turns or until /terse. (`E-003/E003-E4-020`)

Debug refuses raw payloads; release logs/stat-counts them. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E6-004`)

With one local family it may use cloud Sonnet only under `ELAI_ALLOW_CLOUD_ADVERSARY=1`; otherwise it refuses auditing and emits `CrossFamilyUnavailable`. `adversary_verdict_required` is true for code/architecture/security claims. ### E-9: Agent Eval Benchmarks
- **Status**: shipped (plan-recorded claim; deep pass did not independently verify)
- **Anchors**: DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L97, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L98, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L99, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L100, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L101, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L102, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L103, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L104, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L105, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L106, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L107, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L108, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L109, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L110
- **Composes with**: D-19, D-25, B-37, B-23, D-22, D-21, D-2, D-30, E-7, E-8, E-10
- **Behaviors**:
  - The suite anchors internal D-19..D-25 measures to contamination-resistant 2026 public benchmarks and makes harness-vs-model decomposition mandatory beside scores. (`E-003/E003-E9-001`)
  - Effort is three sessions; B-37 is required, B-23 optional, D-22 supplies calibration, D-19..D-25 are extended, and .elai_cc/benches/external plus paired-bootstrap gating are new. (`E-003/E003-E9-002`)
  - BenchmarkSuite exposes name, version, run(model,harness), and paired_bootstrap_significance(a,b); its registry holds eleven implementations. (`E-003/E003-E9-003`)
  - Core symbols are BenchmarkSuite, HarnessConfig, BenchmarkResult, paired_bootstrap_p(a,b,n_iter), and ds_cp_coverage(calib_set,shift_set,alpha). (`E-003/E003-E9-004`)
  - SWE-bench-Live pulls the latest 50 issues, uses a 24-hour HTTP cache, verifies content hash and temporal cutoff, and executes through the existing CLI run pipeline. (`E-003/E003-E9-005`)
  - SWE-bench-Live blocks promotion only when month-over-month loss exceeds two points and paired-bootstrap p<0.05, then emits SweBenchLiveRunCompleted. (`E-003/E003-E9-006`)
  - LiveCodeBench v6 uses a last-60-days slice, PerRoleRuntime, and code-generation, self-repair, and test-output-prediction subtasks. (`E-003/E003-E9-007`)
  - LiveCodeBench floors are 30% local and 45% cloud with per-language breakdown, emitting LiveCodeBenchRunCompleted. (`E-003/E003-E9-008`)
  - tau2-bench covers retail and telecom and grades policy adherence rather than successful outcome, so a policy-violating booking fails. (`E-003/E003-E9-009`)
  - tau2 floors are retail .70 cloud/.55 local and telecom .85 cloud/.55 local, separately reported with Tau2BenchRunCompleted. (`E-003/E003-E9-010`)
  - BFCL v3 uses a multi-turn, per-role function-calling slice, complements D-21, has a 70% floor, and emits BfclV3RunCompleted. (`E-003/E003-E9-011`)
  - GAIA L1/L2 uses the HAL framework and a contracts fixture; shipped promotion requires L1≥50% and L2≥30%, with GaiaRunCompleted. (`E-003/E003-E9-012`)
  - ClawsBench runs {model A,model B}×{harness X,harness Y} and decomposes two-way ANOVA variance into model, harness, and interaction effects. (`E-003/E003-E9-013`)
  - ClawsBench emits model_effect_pp/harness_effect_pp, accompanies every harness/scaffold diff, and forbids model attribution when model spread is under 10pp within a harness. (`E-003/E003-E9-014`)
  - PRMBench uses Deception Resistance and Circular Logic subsets, gates D-2 PPM at the published baseline, and emits PrmBenchRunCompleted. (`E-003/E003-E9-015`)
  - Sharma probes cover feedback flip, mimicry, answer flip, and false-claim agreement; flip rate under 15% gates auditor/planner persona changes and emits SycophancyProbeCompleted. (`E-003/E003-E9-016`)
  - Math floors use cleaned GSM8K-Platinum, never raw GSM8K, plus MATH-500; local floors are 90% and 50%, with MathFloorsCompleted. (`E-003/E003-E9-017`)
  - HLE is a 50-question no-tools ceiling slice run quarterly for trend only, never a regression gate, and emits HleCeilingTracked. (`E-003/E003-E9-018`)
  - DeepPlanning tests 2-3-day plan fixtures with ≥70% constraint satisfaction and emits DeepPlanningCompleted. (`E-003/E003-E9-019`)
  - DS-CP replaces plain conformal, evaluates in-domain/near-OOD/far-OOD distributions, requires coverage gap under 5pp, and emits DsCpCoverageMeasured. (`E-003/E003-E9-020`)
  - The paired-bootstrap harness estimates required task count for p<.05 on a two-point delta from observed variance and emits BenchPowerCalibrated(required_n,observed_n). (`E-003/E003-E9-021`)
  - If observed_n is below required_n it emits LowPowerNoConclusion and must not label the result a regression. (`E-003/E003-E9-022`)
  - CLI command elai bench external accepts --suite NAME, --harness-vary, and --p-target 0.05, launches Python runners, tails SSB, and prints pass/fail/low-power verdicts. (`E-003/E003-E9-023`)

  - get_external_bench_history(suite_name) returns Vec<BenchmarkResult> through Tauri. (`E-003/E003-E9-025`)

  - Contamination defense must combine n-gram, paraphrase, and canary checks; n-gram-only filtering is forbidden. (`E-003/E003-E9-027`)

### E-12: Production Fullstack Codegen
- **Status**: planned (plan-recorded; not independently verified shipped)
- **Anchors**: DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L157, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L158, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L159, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L160, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L161, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L162, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L163, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L164, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L165, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L166, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L167, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L168, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L169, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L170
- **Composes with**: B-30, B-37, C-21, C-31, C-32, E-11, E-13, E-14, E-18
- **Behaviors**:
  - ProductionGrade codegen moves beyond compile/tests by adding framework conventions, RLS, secrets, OWASP, observability seeds, and consolidated deny-quality tooling. (`E-003/E003-E12-001`)
  - Effort is three sessions; B-30/B-37/C-21/C-31/C-32/E-11 are dependencies, E-13/E-14 are parallel, and FrameworkAdapter plus manifests are net-new extensions. (`E-003/E003-E12-002`)
  - Seven convention manifests are named: wasp, encore, redwoodsdk, t3, hono, fastapi, and nextjs-app-router. (`E-003/E003-E12-003`)
  - Each manifest is token-compact (<200 lines), plain text plus fenced YAML, and contains root config, route/auth/db/env conventions, scaffold command, linter/formatter/test defaults, dependency manifests, and banned patterns. (`E-003/E003-E12-004`)
  - Manifest bans include stale Tailwind-v3 classes in v4 projects, localStorage JWTs, production prisma/drizzle push, and hard-coded admin credentials. (`E-003/E003-E12-005`)
  - FrameworkProfile variants are Wasp, EncoreDev, RedwoodSdk, T3Stack, HonoEdge, FastApi, NextAppRouter, and Generic. (`E-003/E003-E12-006`)
  - FrameworkAdapter exposes scaffold(ProjectSpec)→FileSpec list, production_checklist(), and apply_lint_defaults(FilePlan). (`E-003/E003-E12-007`)
  - IdeaFramer ProjectClass deterministically selects a profile through PROJECT_CLASS_TO_FRAMEWORK/config. (`E-003/E003-E12-008`)
  - Defaults map SaaS→WaspOrEncore, ApiBackend→Hono, AiApp→HonoCloudflare, Marketplace→Encore, and ContentSite→Astro. (`E-003/E003-E12-009`)
  - secrets_scan runs gitleaks plus trufflehog with 30-second timeout. (`E-003/E003-E12-010`)
  - owasp_static runs semgrep p/owasp-top-ten with a 60-second timeout. (`E-003/E003-E12-011`)
  - rls_probe parses sqlite3/pg_dump output and flags CREATE TABLE without ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY. (`E-003/E003-E12-012`)
  - auth_hardening checks HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite cookies, /auth rate limits, and absence of demo admin accounts. (`E-003/E003-E12-013`)
  - dep_audit runs npm audit, pip-audit, and cargo-audit with JSON output. (`E-003/E003-E12-014`)
  - otel_present requires Sentry.init and OTel resource attributes in the server entry. (`E-003/E003-E12-015`)
  - structured_logging performs grep plus fixture sanity validation of log format. (`E-003/E003-E12-016`)
  - axe_lighthouse uses lighthouse-ci, requires ≥95 on critical pages, and runs only when frontend_pair is non-null. (`E-003/E003-E12-017`)
  - tdd_fail_first inspects git history: a new test’s first commit is alone and the second adds implementation. (`E-003/E003-E12-018`)
  - integration_real_dep rejects integration tests that use an all-mock harness. (`E-003/E003-E12-019`)
  - migration_push_ban rejects production-path prisma db push and drizzle-kit push scripts. (`E-003/E003-E12-020`)
  - linter_clean runs Biome, Ruff, and Clippy with warnings denied. (`E-003/E003-E12-021`)
  - localstorage_jwt rejects token writes to browser localStorage. (`E-003/E003-E12-022`)
  - dockerfile_secrets rejects secret-bearing ENV and requires BuildKit secret mounts. (`E-003/E003-E12-023`)
  - iac_policy_as_code uses CrossGuard/Checkov and forbids global ingress, disabled PublicAccessBlock, and open S3 buckets. (`E-003/E003-E12-024`)

### E-18: Tool-Use Reliability
- **Status**: shipped (plan-recorded claim; deep pass did not independently verify)
- **Anchors**: DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L215, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L216, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L217, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L218, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L219, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L220, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L221, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L222, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L223, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L224, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L225, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L226, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L227, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L228
- **Composes with**: B-37, B-20, C-13, D-13, E-26, E-27, E-32, E-2, E-44
- **Behaviors**:
  - The tool path is hardened with XGrammar, a Hermes envelope, SEARCH/REPLACE fences, one-shot error-aware recovery, and ToolResult spill, addressing malformed JSON, escape bugs, retry loops, edit disorientation, package hallucination, and long responses. (`E-003/E003-E18-001`)
  - Effort is two-to-three sessions; B-7b and B-37 are shipped prerequisites, B-20 and C-13 are planned integration frames, and D-13 remains a later cross-family verifier. (`E-003/E003-E18-002`)
  - server.py replaces regex/in-house constraints with xgrammar.GrammarMatcher and a transformers LogitsProcessor. (`E-003/E003-E18-003`)
  - All fifteen IPC schemas plus tool schemas precompile at sidecar boot; any compile failure is a startup error, never a fallback. (`E-003/E003-E18-004`)
  - Grammar masking requires the Hermes <tool_call>...</tool_call> envelope and makes the known fenced-json fallback impossible at token selection. (`E-003/E003-E18-005`)
  - A Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-NF4 sidecar smoke fuzzes 100 tool prompts and requires 100% envelope presence. (`E-003/E003-E18-006`)
  - Edit tier one becomes SearchReplaceMatcher with exact fences <<< ELAI_SEARCH, === ELAI_REPLACE, and >>> ELAI_END. (`E-003/E003-E18-007`)
  - DelimiterCollisionGuard scans for the custom tokens and git conflict markers; any collision falls back to whole-file rewrite. (`E-003/E003-E18-008`)
  - Tier-2 validation failure or a SEARCH/REPLACE miss gets exactly one reprompt containing a structured <tool_error>; a second failure escalates to .claude/agents/fixer.md. (`E-003/E003-E18-009`)

### E-26: Inference Engines 2026
- **Status**: shipped (plan-recorded claim; deep pass did not independently verify)
- **Anchors**: DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L263, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L264, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L265, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L266, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L267, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L268, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L269, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L270, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L271, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L272, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L273, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L274, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L275, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L276
- **Composes with**: B-37, E-2, E-27, E-32, E-54
- **Behaviors**:
  - E-26 feeds PS-4 routing economics through a SGLang throughput tier and Ollama demotion; the live $/verified-task leg remains blocked on J-28. (`E-003/E003-E26-001`)
  - The runtime policy is hybrid: SGLang for cloud planner/critic/structured JSON, custom Sidecar for research/DoLa/ETC/steering/TurboQuant, and Ollama deprecated but retained. (`E-003/E003-E26-002`)
  - B-37 is shipped prerequisite; S1-S4 are free-lane shippable, while S5 is gated on unresolved E-2 Part-3 plus RunPod. (`E-003/E003-E26-003`)
  - B-37’s eleven backends become twelve with Sglang; Vllm remains untouched and Sidecar’s processor chain remains canonical. (`E-003/E003-E26-004`)
  - Existing media-validator SglangConfig and new long-lived SglangRuntimeConfig are distinct lifecycle types and must not be collapsed. (`E-003/E003-E26-005`)
  - SglangBackend implements RuntimeAdapter over OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions and native /generate endpoints, with /v1/models health and SSE streaming. (`E-003/E003-E26-006`)
  - SglangRuntimeConfig contains base_url, optional api_key, request_timeout, and StructuredOutputBackend. (`E-003/E003-E26-007`)
  - StructuredOutputBackend variants are XGrammar, Outlines, and LMFE; response_format JSON schema and native regex are both supported. (`E-003/E003-E26-008`)
  - The adapter is HTTP-only and must not launch sgl-server; request-ID hashing uses blake3. (`E-003/E003-E26-009`)
  - Factory registration adds runtime/mod.rs module exposure, adapter enum/factory arms, resolve_backend("sglang"), and existing permission opt-in. (`E-003/E003-E26-010`)
  - With a healthy configured endpoint, planner, critic, prompt_engineer, and structured-JSON callers route to Sglang; research, executor, and memory_writer keep existing routes. (`E-003/E003-E26-011`)

### E-27: Quantization 2026
- **Status**: planned (plan-recorded; not independently verified shipped)
- **Anchors**: DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L318, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L319, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L320, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L321, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L322, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L323, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L324, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L325, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L326, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L327, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L328, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L329, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L330, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L331
- **Composes with**: B-37, E-26, E-28, E-2
- **Behaviors**:
  - Serving evaluates AWQ+Marlin W4A16 and FP8 KV while preserving NF4 for QLoRA; migration order is FP8 KV, then AWQ, then a separate QLoRA checkpoint path. (`E-003/E003-E27-001`)
  - Effort is two sessions; B-37 is required, E-26 optional, and E-26/E-28/E-2 require coordinated server.py windows but are logically orthogonal. (`E-003/E003-E27-002`)
  - ELAI_QUANT_BACKEND is nf4|awq|fp16 and defaults to nf4 for backward compatibility; --quant-backend awq plumbs to it. (`E-003/E003-E27-003`)
  - AWQ loads through AwqConfig(version="marlin") on compute capability ≥8.0 and falls back to version="gemm" before Ampere. (`E-003/E003-E27-004`)
  - NF4 loading remains available and may not be deleted because it serves QLoRA fine-tuning. (`E-003/E003-E27-005`)
  - ELAI_KV_CACHE_DTYPE is fp16|fp8_e4m3|fp8_e5m2 and defaults to fp16. (`E-003/E003-E27-006`)
  - FP8 KV uses native hardware on Ada+ and a software-simulated path on Ampere. (`E-003/E003-E27-007`)
  - Ampere simulation emits kv_cache_dtype_software_sim and records the approximately 5% throughput cost. (`E-003/E003-E27-008`)
  - ModelCapabilityProfile gains quant_format and five VRAM-tier recommendations. (`E-003/E003-E27-009`)
  - The 8GB tier uses Qwen2.5-Coder-3B AWQ-Marlin with GGUF Q5_K_M fallback when AWQ is unavailable. (`E-003/E003-E27-010`)
  - The 12GB tier uses Qwen2.5-Coder-7B AWQ-Marlin plus FP8 KV. (`E-003/E003-E27-011`)
  - The 24GB tier targets Qwen2.5-Coder-14B AWQ-Marlin while EXL3 is deferred. (`E-003/E003-E27-012`)
  - The 48GB tier uses Qwen2.5-Coder-32B FP8 W8A8 on Ada+ or AWQ+FP8KV on Ampere. (`E-003/E003-E27-013`)
  - The 48GB+B200 tier reserves future NVFP4+QAD. (`E-003/E003-E27-014`)
  - ResearchTierConfig keeps NF4+FA2 only for QLoRA-eligible use and selects AWQ-Marlin+FA2+FP8KV for ≥12GB serving tiers. (`E-003/E003-E27-015`)
  - Five dated rules BLOCK AWQ without Marlin/Machete, sub-W4/W4A8 reasoning cliffs, and TurboQuant<4-bit KV; they WARN on NF4 beyond 40K and GGUF Q4_K_M for code. (`E-003/E003-E27-016`)
  - build_awq.py takes a checkpoint and default 256-line code calibration sample and creates a coexisting Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-AWQ checkpoint. (`E-003/E003-E27-017`)
  - autoawq must pass PyPI anti-slopsquatting verification before dependency addition. (`E-003/E003-E27-018`)
  - REMOTE-SIDECAR documents an alternate AWQ+fp8_e5m2 boot while retaining the NF4 boot as default. (`E-003/E003-E27-019`)
  - Five fixed prompt classes run at temperature zero under NF4 and AWQ; the gate requires HumanEval parity and token-cosine >.95 rather than byte equality. (`E-003/E003-E27-020`)
  - Long-context regression sweeps 8K/16K/25K, requires code-completion parity, and writes awq_vs_nf4_longctx.csv. (`E-003/E003-E27-021`)
  - Both features ship default-off for a telemetry week; 12GB+ defaults flip only in a later patch after tasks 8/9 pass three consecutive remote-3090 runs. (`E-003/E003-E27-022`)
  - E-27-decisions records W4A16, FP8-not-TurboQuant, Marlin-not-GPTQ-Marlin, NF4-QLoRA carve-out, and EXL3/NVFP4/MXFP4/TurboQuant non-goals. (`E-003/E003-E27-023`)
  - Produced identifiers are AwqMarlinLoader, Fp8KvCacheConfig, build script/tests, QuantBackendSelected, KvCacheDtypeSoftwareSim, AwqCheckpointBuilt, and five rule rows. (`E-003/E003-E27-024`)
  - Env boot selects weights/cache and emits SSB; build_awq creates the checkpoint through a separate user-invoked path. (`E-003/E003-E27-025`)
  - Stub bans forbid unimplemented Marlin, silent NF4 fallback, EXL3 imports, and TurboQuant<4-bit KV; no new frontend is required. (`E-003/E003-E27-026`)
  - The live artifact target is ≥3× NF4 tok/s, sustained 25K parity, and VRAM ≤2.0GB for 3B/≤4.5GB for 7B, with quant_backend_selected payload including backend, kv dtype, compute capability, and marlin flag. (`E-003/E003-E27-027`)
  - Deterministic checks verify env branches, build script, profiles, tier strings, rules, events, hardware tests, and decisions. (`E-003/E003-E27-028`)
  - Acceptance requires Marlin boot, native/sim FP8 evidence, five-prompt parity, 25K parity, held-out HumanEval non-regression, recorded tok/s on 3060/3090, preserved NF4, no deferred formats, event round-trip, and green hardware/workspace tests. (`E-003/E003-E27-029`)
  - Tests cover five-prompt parity, long-context sweep, native/sim cache behavior, event round-trip, and 12/24/48GB profile resolution. (`E-003/E003-E27-030`)
  - Four Python scripts/tests, two Rust contracts, and decisions are created; server, pyproject, profiles, tiers, rules, SSB, and remote boot docs are modified. (`E-003/E003-E27-031`)
  - Qwen-7B Marlin speed, long-context curve, and FP8 code impact are unmeasured; Ampere defaults FP8 off until parity evidence, and autoawq version must be reverified. (`E-003/E003-E27-032`)
  - EXL3, NVFP4/MXFP4, TurboQuant KV, and embedding-store TurboQuant are not adopted; future patches promote AWQ and add 14B/Blackwell lanes. (`E-003/E003-E27-033`)
  - Inferred: AWQ checkpoints can compose with future SGLang serving, but no SGLang model-loader changes are specified here. (`E-003/E003-E27-034`)
  - Ambiguity: The source says Ada+ uses native FP8 and Ampere simulation, but acceptance wording associates fp8_e5m2 with Ada+ without pinning which FP8 variant each architecture should prefer. (`E-003/E003-E27-035`)
  - Conflict: The orientation summary says “switch serving from NF4 to AWQ”; the original keeps nf4 as the default and AWQ default-off until a later three-run promotion. (`E-003/E003-E27-036`)
  - Conflict: 4.4× is cited from external 32B measurements and “identical HumanEval”; the implementation’s live target is ≥3× plus local parity, so 4.4× is not the immediate acceptance floor. (`E-003/E003-E27-037`)
  - Summary-delta: `ADDITION` (DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L604): Add all env/default/fallback semantics, five VRAM profiles, five policy rules, code-aware AWQ build, alternate boot, parity/long-context CSV tests, three-run telemetry rollout, exact events, hardware artifacts, and deferred formats. (`E-003/DELTA-E003-E27-01`)
  - Summary-delta: `CORRECTION` (DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L605): nf4/fp16 remain the default path initially; AWQ/FP8 are default-off and only a later patch promotes 12GB+ after three consecutive passes. (`E-003/DELTA-E003-E27-02`)
  - Summary-delta: `CORRECTION` (DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L606): The live acceptance target is ≥3× plus parity, not a guaranteed 4.4×; 4.4× is cited external evidence. (`E-003/DELTA-E003-E27-03`)

### E-32: Context Window Extension
- **Status**: planned (plan-recorded; not independently verified shipped)
- **Anchors**: DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L365, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L366, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L367, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L368, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L369, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L370, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L371, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L372, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L373, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L374, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L375, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L376, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L377, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L378
- **Composes with**: B-37, B-31, E-31, B-32, C-13
- **Behaviors**:
  - The plan combines a native 32K ceiling, training-free FITM calibration, an opt-in 64K DCA deep lane, and a loud rejection of YaRN on the default coder model. (`E-003/E003-E32-001`)
  - Effort is one-to-two sessions; B-37 and the knowledge engine exist, B-31 is parallel, E-31 supplies canonical VRAM gating, and no C/D plan overlaps FITM/context. (`E-003/E003-E32-002`)
  - Documentation currently presents 25K as hard ceiling and 20K production, while runtime_client’s code default is 131,072; E-32 changes docs/env guidance, not that code default. (`E-003/E003-E32-003`)
  - CLAUDE.md changes the documented hard ceiling to 32,000 and production guidance to 25,000-28,000 with grounded VRAM/model-card rationale. (`E-003/E003-E32-004`)
  - REMOTE-SIDECAR changes production/max guidance to 25K/32K and recomputes the 85% handoff point as 27,200 tokens. (`E-003/E003-E32-005`)
  - FoundInTheMiddleCalibrator runs only when prompt_len>8K and ELAI_FITM_ENABLED=1, using a second forward pass with a dummy replacement and subtracting positional prior. (`E-003/E003-E32-006`)
  - ELAI_FITM_DUMMY_TEXT defaults to a 50-token lorem block and no dummy may exceed 100 tokens. (`E-003/E003-E32-007`)
  - FITM inserts after existing DoLa/ETC/steering processors and is a no-op with no extra forward pass for prompts ≤8K. (`E-003/E003-E32-008`)
  - FITM defaults OFF and can become default-on only after an internal 20-50-trace RAG evaluation shows at least +5pp recall@3. (`E-003/E003-E32-009`)
  - Each applied calibration emits fitm_calibration_applied with prompt_len, dummy_len, and applied_ms. (`E-003/E003-E32-010`)
  - The sidecar Anthropic request gains a per-request fitm override, defaulting to environment configuration. (`E-003/E003-E32-011`)
  - ELAI_DEEP_MODE=1 on a box with at least 24GB loads Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-1M instead of the standard abliterated 7B. (`E-003/E003-E32-012`)
  - Deep mode enables DCA chunked prefill and hard-caps context at 64K. (`E-003/E003-E32-013`)
  - On less than 24GB deep mode is refused, falls back to standard mode, logs a warning, and must not crash. (`E-003/E003-E32-014`)
  - Successful deep-mode boot emits deep_mode_activated with model_id, ctx_cap, and vram_gb. (`E-003/E003-E32-015`)
  - At a SessionDag handoff, cross-file synthesis means more than three referenced files and no retrieval-localized answer; if a reachable 24GB box exists, local deep mode is preferred over cloud. (`E-003/E003-E32-016`)
  - The escalation emits deep_mode_escalation_chosen with reason and files_referenced. (`E-003/E003-E32-017`)
  - ELAI_USE_YARN=1 with Qwen2.5-Coder raises a cited SidecarBootError and instructs use of DCA deep mode instead. (`E-003/E003-E32-018`)
  - The YaRN refusal path emits YarnRefused/yarn_refused; loud refusal with no silent fallback is acceptance-required. (`E-003/E003-E32-019`)
  - run_fitm_eval.py reads 20-50 workflow/session retrieval traces, compares FITM on/off recall@3 and recall@5 locally, and writes dated JSON results. (`E-003/E003-E32-020`)
  - Handoff threshold is 85% of sidecar-reported effective_max_context and may not hard-code 20K, 25K, or 32K. (`E-003/E003-E32-021`)
  - A-MEM Zettelkasten memory is deferred because it overlaps B-31/B-32 knowledge and symbol graphs. (`E-003/E003-E32-022`)
  - E-32-decisions records 32K-vs-YaRN, the +5pp FITM gate, 24GB cross-file deep-mode gating, and explicit non-goals YaRN, StreamingLLM, Ring Attention, Infini-attention, and 1M serving. (`E-003/E003-E32-023`)
  - Produced identifiers are FoundInTheMiddleCalibrator, activate_deep_mode, refuse_yarn_at_boot, deep_mode_escalation_hook, four SSB variants, and the FITM evaluation scaffold. (`E-003/E003-E32-024`)
  - The sidecar processor chain, Sidecar request passthrough, grounding-client threshold, boot checks, long-request calibration, and handoff escalation form the reachability paths. (`E-003/E003-E32-025`)
  - Stub bans prohibit reachable YaRN, hard-coded context thresholds, oversized dummy text, deep boot below 24GB, untyped boundary errors, and non-blake3 cache hashing. (`E-003/E003-E32-026`)
  - RuntimePanel shows effective_max_context and deep-mode status. (`E-003/E003-E32-027`)
  - A 27,200-token four-file smoke with FITM and a 24GB remote expects calibration, escalation, activation, 32K telemetry, and an AuditTimeline handoff event. (`E-003/E003-E32-028`)
  - Deterministic checks validate docs, calibrator, deep activation, YaRN refusal, four event arms, eval scaffold, dynamic threshold, and an end-to-end FITM SSB row. (`E-003/E003-E32-029`)
  - Acceptance requires docs, processor order, per-long-request evidence, 24GB DCA boot/refusal, escalation and refusal evidence, dynamic threshold, decisions, short-request no-op, no unwrap, and blake3. (`E-003/E003-E32-030`)
  - Tests cover ≤8K no-op/>8K extra pass/bounded delta, YaRN typed failure, 24GB activation/12GB fallback, FITM/deep SSB schema, and dynamic handoff. (`E-003/E003-E32-031`)
  - CLAUDE/remote docs, server, escalation policy, Sidecar, grounding client, SSB, and RuntimePanel are modified; FITM eval and decisions are created. (`E-003/E003-E32-032`)
  - Risks are unmeasured 12GB 32K VRAM, workload-specific FITM lift, slow deep boot, mock-sidecar compatibility, a hard YaRN break, A-MEM overlap, and local-deep-vs-cloud policy. (`E-003/E003-E32-033`)
  - If sidecar effective_max_context is unavailable, threshold logic may use a sane 25K compatibility fallback. (`E-003/E003-E32-034`)
  - A-MEM and PINE are deferred; B-31 must avoid double FITM, C-13 consumes events, and E-31 must receive the 24GB deep-mode row. (`E-003/E003-E32-035`)
  - Inferred: FITM and deep-mode escalation can occur in one long request sequence, but state transfer between the standard and deep sidecars is not specified. (`E-003/E003-E32-036`)
  - Ambiguity: “Refuse to boot deep mode” and “fall back to standard mode” coexist; the operative acceptance behavior is non-crashing fallback, but whether the process reports boot success or a typed recoverable error is unspecified. (`E-003/E003-E32-037`)
  - Conflict: The title/objective says lift 25K→32K, while the current documented production setting is 20K and runtime code defaults to 131,072; this is a documentation/effective-policy lift, not a single code constant change. (`E-003/E003-E32-038`)
  - Conflict: The orientation summary omits the 64K Qwen-1M DCA deep-mode lane and handoff escalation, both major original features. (`E-003/E003-E32-039`)
  - Conflict: The orientation summary invents context_lifted_32k and fitm_recall_lift_measured events and a 15pp target; the original events are FitmCalibrationApplied/DeepModeActivated/DeepModeEscalationChosen/YarnRefused and its deployment gate is measured +5pp on ELAI data. ### E-36: Document Vision RAG
- **Status**: planned
- **Anchors**: DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L235, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L236, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L237, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L238, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L239, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L240, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L241, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L242, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L243, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L244, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L245, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L246, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L247, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L248
- **Composes with**: B-42, B-35, B-37, E-17, C-7, E-39, E-0
- **Behaviors**:
  - **PLANNED, 3 sessions/10-14h.** Adds an opt-in vision side to B-42 Cosmos/B-35 ArtifactCheck/B-37 runtimes and requires E-17 RRF; C-7 SSB substrate must land first. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-001`)
  - Text RAG remains primary for grep-able content. Vision retrieval is additive only for diagrams/scans/screens/slides; VLM captions are retrieval evidence, never authoritative grounding. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-002`)
  - Extends - not replaces - Cosmos. Adds `doc_parser` backends and `vision_verifier`; expands E-17 fusion from three to four lists; adds five vision SSB types; schema pin is deliberately TBD at execution. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-003`)
  - `elai doctor knowledge-models --vision` probes presence, tokenizer hash and size. Default `[knowledge.vision_retriever] model="colmodernvbert"`; alternate ColQwen2.5-v0.2; models live under `models_dir_path()`. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-004`)
  - `VisionChunk={source_blake3,page_idx,multi_vec:Vec<[f16;128]>,pooled,vlm_caption,parser_confidence}`; pool ~1,030 vectors to ~100 (≤128 contract), store in project SQLite `vision_chunks` keyed by source blake3. The cited pooling algorithm must be verified first. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-005`)
  - `PdfStructuredChunker` uses PaddleOCR-VL via `doc_parser` and returns markdown, HTML tables, figure crops, page confidences and `fallback_recommended`. Markdown goes to text chunking, figures to image chunking; any page confidence <0.85 forces image indexing. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-006`)
  - Cosmos gains `Diagram`, `ArchImage`, `Screenshot`, `ScannedDoc` schemas. Diagram stale-checks source **or** render; the other three stale-check source-file blake3. `ParserBackend` includes Paddle/MinerU/Dolphin plus three cloud parsers. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-007`)
  - Visual-spatial claims dispatch to `GroundingMethod::VisualArtifactCheck`: top-k image retrieval then Qwen2.5-VL structured `{verdict:Confirm | Refute | Indeterminate,evidence_pages,reliability:VlmCaption | OcrParse | DiagramSource}`. Consumers must downweight VLM-caption reliability. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-008`)
  - `RrfFusion4` uses default weights `{bm25:1.0,code_vec:1.0,text_vec:0.8,vision_vec:0.6}`, emits `rrf_vision_component_weight`, and omits the vision list when disabled. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-009`)
  - `[knowledge.vision_rag] enabled=false` is a hard shipping default. Disabled ingest stores caption+hash for visually rich inputs but skips multi-vectors; enabled stores the index. `VisionRagPolicyDecision` records enabled/budget/actual storage. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-010`)
  - Cloud parser fallback threshold defaults .7 and is eligible only outside `--mode local`; local refuses and logs `DocParserCloudFallbackBlockedByMode`; cloud cost consumes task spend ceiling. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-011`)
  - Separate 50-query gold set evaluates ColModernVBERT vs ColQwen at nDCG@5/Recall@5/MRR. At least one backend must reach nDCG@5≥.50 before any policy default-enables vision. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-012`)
  - CosmosDrawer extension or `VisionRAGDrawer` shows index state, storage, parse confidence and latest verdict/reliability; Tauri exposes `get_vision_artifact_status` and `get_vision_artifact_check_recent`. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-013`)
  - Wiring exports chunkers/schemas/artifact types/parser enum/verdict/reliability/RRF4, doctor probe and five events: `VisionChunkEmitted`, `VisionFallbackTriggered`, `VisualArtifactCheckVerdict`, `VisionRagPolicyDecision`, `DocParserCloudFallbackBlockedByMode`. Entry points are CLI, query pipeline, Tauri and verification dispatch. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-014`)
  - Negative contract: no unwrap, non-blake3 file hash, caption-only authority, full 1,030-vector storage, auto-enable, MarkItDown for image PDFs, Nougat, or local-mode cloud fallback. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-015`)
  - Smoke verifies an auth-diagram redirect claim and requires chunk/check/RRF rows, blake3-keyed database row, nonempty pages on determinate verdicts and a four-stage query trace. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-016`)
  - Deterministic checks cover hashes, enum+dispatch, four artifact types, parser registration, pooling cap, default-off config, five SSB variants, RRF4, two eval files and staged-model doctor output. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-017`)
  - Done gates require staged hash/size, working Paddle confidence, ≤25KB/page pooled storage, correct stale policy, routed reliability-aware verdict, opt-in RRF participation, mode/threshold fallback, .50 corpus nDCG and blake3-only code. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-018`)
  - Tests cover visual-vs-file dispatch, pooling recall within ±2 points, low/high parser confidence, LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH reliability mapping, three-run stable four-list ordering, diagram-render staleness and corpus nDCG gate. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-019`)
  - File lifecycle creates two chunkers, verifier, optional/new drawer, eval corpus/driver, five contracts and decision doc; modifies Cosmos, pipeline, verification, runtime, SSB, doctor, Tauri and config docs. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-020`)
  - Pooling citation is unverified; if absent, use measured max/mean pooling. Target budget is 25KB/page and suggested project default 500MB; emit over-budget evidence. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-021`)
  - Local VRAM cannot hold coder+VLM concurrently; captioning is ingest-time batch or remote billable sidecar that must be stopped after use. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-022`)
  - Do not default-enable without local-corpus .50 nDCG; all downstream gates must inspect reliability; cloud multimodal reranking is deferred; C-7 blocks entry if not shipped. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-023`)
  - Next: compose B-35+E-17 for text/vision retrieval; defer cloud reranking, reasoning-tier ColBERT and vision-chunk PageRank; coordinate cloud parse spend with E-39. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-024`)
  - Interaction: E-36 consumes C-7 Cosmos events, B-35 ArtifactCheck registry, B-37 roles and E-17 RRF; C-7 can block entry, and E-39 must govern cloud parse spend. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-INT-008`)
  - Interaction: Visual grounding combines image retrieval with a runtime VLM, but reliability tier controls downstream auditor/scope-planner weight and local mode can forbid cloud parsing. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-INT-009`)
  - Inferred: Mixed PDF ingest likely parses text/tables, crops figures, conditionally indexes image multi-vectors, then fuses four retrieval lists and verifies visual claims; atomic steps are explicit but transaction/partial-failure recovery is absent. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-INF-005`)
  - Ambiguity: “8th GroundingMethod” counting is unstable: FILE/SOURCE/TEST/WEB/API/API_REGISTRY + ArtifactCheck + CosmosCheck already names eight before VisualArtifactCheck; `VerificationMethod` versus `GroundingMethod` naming also shifts. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-AMB-010`)
  - Ambiguity: Pool-to-~100 algorithm is contingent on verifying a cited paper; fallback max/mean method and recall selection rule are not chosen. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-AMB-011`)
  - Ambiguity: Storage budget records a 500MB suggested default, but task schema names only budget/actual and does not specify eviction/rejection when exceeded. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-AMB-012`)
  - Conflict: E-36:47 vs E-36:57 | Page confidence <.85 forces image indexing; cloud fallback threshold defaults .7. Pages in [.7,.85) get vision indexing without cloud parse, which may be intentional but the two “fallback” labels can be mistaken as one rule. Preserve as two distinct gates. - **Behaviors**:
  - Close the unguarded data plane - web results, extracted content, uploads, tool results, images, and sandbox output - while retaining existing control-plane visibility/schema/deny-list defenses (L1-L2, L8-L10, L23-L31). (`E-004/E004.E37.EX001`)
  - E-24 must land first for MCP schema pin/sanitization/transport, C-11 supplies Tier-C isolation, and B-37 supplies the classifier route; E-36/E-39/E-40 are parallel (L3-L6, L25-L31). (`E-004/E004.E37.EX002`)
  - Defense must be layered: Spotlighting, per-tool description pin, off-model classifier, provenance/capability control, ingress/egress filtering, sandbox network denial, MCP-list classification, CI regression, and output classification (L12-L21, L52-L72). (`E-004/E004.E37.EX003`)
  - All tool-description pins use blake3, never SHA-256/blake2/sha2, overriding the source report's transport-hash suggestion (L1-L2, L19, L56, L115). (`E-004/E004.E37.EX004`)
  - `wrap_untrusted` applies a per-request random delimiter and whitespace datamarking to every web-search, extraction, MCP-result, upload, and sandbox-stdout span (L54). (`E-004/E004.E37.EX005`)
  - The system prompt says Spotlighted instructions are data, not commands; the transform is reversible only for presentation and the delimiter is never echoed in user-visible output (L54, L122). (`E-004/E004.E37.EX006`)
  - Every wrap emits `spotlight_envelope_applied` (L54). (`E-004/E004.E37.EX007`)
  - First tool approval stores `blake3(tool.description_canonical)` keyed by server URL/tool name under `.elai_cc/.elai/mcp/tool_descriptions/...toml`, including `pinned_hash,pinned_at,approval_user` (L56). (`E-004/E004.E37.EX008`)
  - Later description mismatch blocks by default, shows the diff, emits a pin violation, and requires explicit `elai mcp pin update <server> <tool>` re-pinning (L56, L89). (`E-004/E004.E37.EX009`)
  - Per-description pinning complements rather than replaces E-24's canonical whole-list/schema pin: one catches mutation, the other tool addition/removal (L56, L100-L101). (`E-004/E004.E37.EX010`)
  - `prompt_armor::classify` uses role `injection_classifier`, default local Qwen 3B with optional Haiku 4.5 fallback, after Spotlighting and before ingest tool use (L26, L58). (`E-004/E004.E37.EX011`)
  - Classifier returns Clean/Suspicious/Block, confidence, and matched pattern IDs (L58, L81-L82). (`E-004/E004.E37.EX012`)
  - Block halts with an agent error and event; Suspicious asks the user unless autonomous plus `--allow-suspicious-ingest`, in which case it logs and proceeds (L58). (`E-004/E004.E37.EX013`)
  - Classification batches about 16-32 spans per sidecar call using cheap-monitor representation reuse (L58). (`E-004/E004.E37.EX014`)
  - `Provenance` has `User,System,WebTierA,WebTierB,WebTierC,McpTool{server_url,tool_name,desc_blake3},Upload{source_path},SandboxOutput{sandbox_id},Memory{source_key}` and wraps values as `Provenanced<T>` (L60, L77-L80). (`E-004/E004.E37.EX015`)
  - Provenance is out-of-band metadata and therefore cannot be forged by text; every argv-construction site is intended to wrap values (L60). (`E-004/E004.E37.EX016`)
  - PreToolUse rejects Bash/filesystem/database/network mutation whenever any argument derives from WebTier or McpTool and records the tool, provenanced argv, and rejecting origin (L62). (`E-004/E004.E37.EX017`)
  - CaMeL-lite is origin-based rather than regex-based; full capability calculus is deferred to E-37.B (L21, L62, L277). (`E-004/E004.E37.EX018`)
  - WebFetcher enforces `[network.egress] allowlist`, defaulting to normal search/arXiv/Hugging Face/GitHub traffic, and emits `egress_blocked` for other destinations (L64). (`E-004/E004.E37.EX019`)
  - T1 PostToolUse strips Markdown image syntax and HTML `<img>` before rendering unless hostname allowlisted (L64). (`E-004/E004.E37.EX020`)
  - Tauri CSP denies `img-src` from non-allowlisted origins (L64). (`E-004/E004.E37.EX021`)
  - Tier-C adds default-deny network namespaces and DNS allowlist; every lookup emits `sandbox_egress_dns_lookup{tool,host,decision}` (L66). (`E-004/E004.E37.EX022`)
  - Every full `list_tools()` description/parameter/return-schema set is classified in `mcp_list_audit` mode after E-24 text sanitization; Block rejects the whole list and emits `mcp_scan_classifier_blocked` (L68). (`E-004/E004.E37.EX023`)
  - Nightly AgentDojo runs 97 tasks×629 security tests against all layers and gates at attack-success rate `<5%`, after package/repository identity verification (L70). (`E-004/E004.E37.EX024`)
  - Before SSB persistence, a local-first classifier detects non-allowlisted URLs, Markdown/HTML/script exfil, and role-tag impersonation and emits `output_classifier_flagged` (L72, L273). (`E-004/E004.E37.EX025`)
  - Produced types include `SpotlightedSpan{raw,datamarked,delimiter:[u8;16]}`, provenance wrappers, classifier/gate/output verdicts, pin status, and CLI pinning (L74-L89). (`E-004/E004.E37.EX026`)

- **Status**: planned
- **Anchors**: DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L264, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L265, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L266, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L267, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L268, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L269, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L270, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L271, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L272, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L273, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L274, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L275, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L276, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L277
- **Composes with**: B-37, D-1, D-7, E-24, E-39, E-37, E-40, C-15, C-27
- **Behaviors**:
  - **PLANNED, strategic/lightweight, 1-2 sessions/6-8h.** B-37 is shipped hedge; D-1..D-7 are planned compliance substrate; no new FSM state. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E38-001`)
  - MoE is treated as the frontier trend; dense Qwen remains valid at 7-12GB but no adapter may encode dense-only assumptions. Future MoE-on-Ampere expert offload is documented, not implemented. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E38-002`)
  - Ampere stays on FA2 while FA3/4 target newer hardware; `ELAI_FORCE_SDPA=1` remains insurance and code must not hard-code FA2. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E38-003`)
  - RAG/mistake_book/Cosmos remain load-bearing through 2027; advertised huge context must not replace layered retrieval without effective-context evidence. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E38-004`)
  - MCP is the selected protocol; bridge must watch stateless transport, Tasks, Registry and SAML/OIDC/PKCE roadmap changes and compose with E-24. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E38-005`)
  - Regulatory hedge is deterministic rules/FSM/evidence/replay. EU high-risk timing is stated postponed; compliance gate targets Articles 12 record-keeping and 13 transparency at `PLANNING→TESTING_FIRST`. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E38-006`)
  - `docs/strategy/ELAI-2026-POSTURE.md` is a ~350-line cited spec covering five signals, seven risky bets, labs, hardware, regulation and architectural insurance; no ungrounded roadmap claim. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E38-007`)
  - `pre_gate_planning_to_testing_first` asserts `ClockProviderIntact`, `DeterministicSeed`, `TemplateHashChain`, `AuditTrailLive`; failure blocks transition and logs assertion+remediation, success logs verification. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E38-008`)
  - CI contract forbids hard FA2 imports/assertions outside try/except fallback in Python inference code and preserves SDPA fallback. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E38-009`)
  - Any backend declaring ≥100K tokens must provide measured `mrcr_v2_score≥0.50` or literal `vendor-claim-only`; the latter emits `MrcrUnverified` at init. Canonical MRCR citation must be looked up, not fabricated. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E38-010`)
  - AST contract keeps `RuntimeAdapter` architecture-blind (no dense/MoE-named methods) and adds an E-38 rationale comment. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E38-011`)
  - `MoE-on-Ampere-tier.md` documents expert CPU/disk offload for named future models/hardware; citations must be verified. It is preparation only. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E38-012`)
  - MCP bridge TODO/watch is runtime no-op except `McpTransportVersionLogged {current,target}` at initialization. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E38-013`)
  - Three anti-pattern contracts forbid non-MCP/Anthropic bespoke agent protocols, screenshot+click agent loops, and FSM transitions without an SSB row. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E38-014`)
  - CLAUDE hard rule points to the posture doc; 2026 lab/timeline claims must cite it or fresh WebFetch, never training memory. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E38-015`)
  - Session protocol checks posture-doc mtime and warns/logs `PostureDocStale` after 90 days; reminder, not runtime hook. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E38-016`)
  - Wiring exports compliance verdict/assertion and five SSB types (`EuAiActComplianceBlocked`, `Verified`, `McpTransportVersionLogged`, `MrcrUnverified`, `PostureDocStale`); consumes runtime, ClockProvider, template archive, SSB and MCP. Synthetic missing-clock smoke must leave FSM in PLANNING with doc-linked error. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E38-017`)

### E-42: Tree-Sitter Grammars 2026
- **Status**: planned
- **Anchors**: DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L294, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L295, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L296, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L297, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L298, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L299, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L300, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L301, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L302, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L303, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L304, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L305, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L306, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L307
- **Composes with**: B-30, B-29, B-26
- **Behaviors**:
  - **PLANNED, 3 sessions/10-12h.** Refines planned B-30 and stabilizes the grammar substrate beneath in-flight B-29; changes `crates/knowledge/src/dkg/`, not chunk-level logic. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E42-001`)
  - Core target is 0.26.x/ABI 15. Grammars are maturity-tiered; composite parsing is one-level outer+injected reparse; Svelte 5 support is explicitly best-effort; Python `tree-sitter-language-pack` is forbidden in Rust. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E42-002`)
  - Cargo exact-pin instruction is `tree-sitter="=0.26"` in every importing crate, documented in `grammars.md`, with `cargo tree` verification against transitive bumps. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E42-003`)
  - `assert_abi_compatibility` calls the 0.26 language-version API for every loaded grammar, accepts versions **14 or 15**, fails fast with actionable error otherwise, and emits per-grammar `GrammarAbiProbeResult`. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E42-004`)
  - TIER-A registration claims “canonical 15” but enumerates rust, python, typescript, tsx, javascript, go, java, c, c-sharp, ruby, php, bash, html, css, json, yaml, toml, markdown; individual canonical crates are verified before addition; Markdown is CommonMark+GFM, never MDX. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E42-005`)
  - `experimental_grammars` gates kotlin, scala, swift, svelte, vue and optional C++; each load emits `GrammarTierBLoaded` with “may emit ERROR nodes.” Kotlin must be the `fwcd/tree-sitter-kotlin` grammar, not bindings. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E42-006`)
  - Svelte precheck detects `$state/$derived/$effect/$props`; tree walk counts ERROR+MISSING. With runes and ERROR rate >5%, downgrade that file to raw-text chunks and warn; emit `SvelteRunesParseHealth {file,error_node_count,missing_node_count,runes_detected}`. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E42-007`)
  - HTML/Svelte/Vue `injections.scm` maps script body→TypeScript and style→CSS and explicitly stops at one injection level. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E42-008`)
  - Experimental Astro split parses `---` frontmatter as TS and body as HTML/JS injections; RSC directives are ordinary TS syntax and have a TIER-A clean-parse regression test. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E42-009`)
  - Existing minified guard is average line length >500; add hard >2MB raw-text fallback and `TreeSitterSkippedLargeFile`; no parser rows for such input. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E42-010`)
  - Webview/WASM grammar path is guarded as unsupported because only Wasmtime is fully supported; predicted 1.5-2× slowdown is acceptable offline, not real-time; attempted load emits `tree_sitter_wasm_unsupported`. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E42-011`)
  - Regenerate `elai.map` with SCIP indices; previously supported languages must retain row count within ±5% and no SCIP_DEF/SCIP_REF regression. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E42-012`)
  - Wiring exports ABI types/functions, TIER-A/B registration and Svelte health plus four declared SSB enum variants. `DkgEngine::build_graph` is entry; CLI indexing flows through it. Smoke covers rs/py/ts/runes-Svelte/>2MB JSON and writes grammar-version audit. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E42-013`)
  - Dependency matrix names 17 TIER-A crates (TS crate also supplies TSX) and five TIER-B crates; mapper is a post-change consumer. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E42-014`)
  - Negative contract forbids language-pack, wrong core range, unwrap around ABI, ungated TIER-B, claims of full Svelte 5 support and MDX advertising. GrammarHealthPanel is optional/B-26-gated. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E42-015`)
  - Deterministic checks require exact pin, ABI definition+call, registration functions/cfg, no meta-dep/MDX, four SSB types, fwcd pin and a one-row-per-grammar audit artifact. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E42-016`)
  - Done gates require builds with/without feature, all ABI 14/15 rows, >5% raw fallback, >2MB skip, comprehensive `grammars.md`, mapper ±5%, no meta-dep/unwrap and an audit table with name/crate/version/ABI/tier/fork URL. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E42-017`)
  - Tests cover valid/invalid ABI, four runes/no false-positive, >5% fallback, 3MB skip, HTML injection, MDX non-crash without support, tier counts and kotlin fork pin. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E42-018`)
  - File lifecycle creates ABI/Svelte modules, `grammars.md`, shared injection query, audit and decision docs; modifies DKG, Cargo and SSB; dashboard panel remains optional. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E42-019`)

### E-44: Checkpointing Durability
- **Status**: shipped (plan-recorded claim; deep pass did not independently verify)
- **Anchors**: DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L415, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L416, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L417, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L418, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L419, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L420, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L421, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L422, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L423, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L424, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L425, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L426, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L427, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L428
- **Composes with**: B-9, B-40, B-42, B-41, E-41, E-42, E-43, E-45, B-26, E-4, E-9, E-12, E-18, E-26, E-27, E-32, E-54
- **Behaviors**:
  - The durability layer adds idempotent tool boundaries, pre-effect SAGA compensation, Continue-As-New, deterministic simulation, lazy migration, compaction locking, optional postcard, reliability metrics, and error taxonomy. (`E-003/E003-E44-001`)
  - Effort is three sessions; B-9/B-40/B-42/B-41 are shipped prerequisites and E-41/E-42/E-43/E-45 are parallel consumers. (`E-003/E003-E44-002`)
  - IdempotencyKey.compose deterministically builds session_id:phase_id:step_id:tool_name:call_seq and is sortable. (`E-003/E003-E44-003`)
  - Every mcp_* and Bash/Edit/Write wrapper accepts the key and checks AgentCheckpoint.tool_results before a real call. (`E-003/E003-E44-004`)
  - A same-key irreversible call replays its cached result; a same-key call with no irreversible SAGA effect may fork/re-execute. (`E-003/E003-E44-005`)
  - Cache/replay paths emit tool_idempotency_hit or tool_idempotency_replayed_irreversible. (`E-003/E003-E44-006`)
  - SSB gains compensation_actions columns session_id, phase_id, action_id, action_name, inverse_action_name, inverse_args_msgpack, written_at, executed_at, and status. (`E-003/E003-E44-007`)
  - Compensation must be durable before an irreversible side effect, never after it. (`E-003/E003-E44-008`)
  - File delete records write_back with previous bytes; git push records revert/reset to previous SHA; pod termination records respawn with previous config. (`E-003/E003-E44-009`)
  - Crash recovery scans committed compensations whose phase is incomplete and replays inverse actions in reverse order. (`E-003/E003-E44-010`)
  - SAGA emits compensation_logged, compensation_replayed, and compensation_failed. (`E-003/E003-E44-011`)
  - SessionDag ceilings are tunable as event_count_ceiling default 500 and phase_count_ceiling default 100. (`E-003/E003-E44-012`)
  - Crossing either ceiling atomically snapshots carry-over, archives old content under session_dag_archive/<old>.archive keyed by blake3, and starts a new root. (`E-003/E003-E44-013`)
  - Rollover emits session_dag_continue_as_new referencing old and new session IDs. (`E-003/E003-E44-014`)
  - agent_pool_dst swaps tokio for madsim only in tests, injects crashes at each supervise await, and checks the three-restarts-per-N-seconds Erlang limit. (`E-003/E003-E44-015`)
  - madsim is an optional dev dependency whose version must be verified with cargo search. (`E-003/E003-E44-016`)
  - checkpoint_migrator registers transforms by (from,to), reads msgpack schema_version on load, applies older transforms in order, and never performs a big-bang migration. (`E-003/E003-E44-017`)
  - Declared transform chain is 40→41, 41→42, 42→44, and 44→45, with gaps confirmed from shipped project records. (`E-003/E003-E44-018`)
  - Migration emits checkpoint_lazy_migrated with from, to, and file_path. (`E-003/E003-E44-019`)
  - PreCompact and the 85%-token trigger acquire a cross-platform CompactLock at workflow/sessions/{id}/.compact-lock before changing SESSION_HANDOFF or SSB. (`E-003/E003-E44-020`)
  - Waiting more than 100ms for the compact lock emits compact_lock_contended. (`E-003/E003-E44-021`)
  - postcard_checkpoints switches the five on-disk files only behind a feature; msgpack remains default and remains mandatory at dashboard IPC. (`E-003/E003-E44-022`)
  - checkpoint_format benchmark records msgpack/postcard size and serde latency in E-44-checkpoint-format-bench-2026-05-19.md without changing the default. (`E-003/E003-E44-023`)
  - AgentPool computes RDC, VAF, graceful_degradation_score, and meltdown_onset_point over rolling windows of 10/50/100 calls. (`E-003/E003-E44-024`)
  - agent_reliability_metrics feeds phase-end audit; detected meltdown recommends escalation or restart. (`E-003/E003-E44-025`)
  - error_taxonomy deterministically classifies transient, semantic, and spec-level ToolErrors into RecoveryDirective. (`E-003/E003-E44-026`)
  - Transient errors retry with backoff, semantic errors trigger step replan, and spec-level failures escalate the phase. (`E-003/E003-E44-027`)
  - Classification emits tool_error_classified with bucket and retry_path. (`E-003/E003-E44-028`)
  - saga_idempotency_e2e injects a crash between compensation and effect, recovers, reuses the key, and asserts no double file write, no duplicate SSB row, and unchanged SessionDag root. (`E-003/E003-E44-029`)
  - Produced functions include IdempotencyKey compose/lookup, SagaLogger log/replay, continue_as_new, migrate, CompactLock acquire, classify, compute_metrics, and ten action types. (`E-003/E003-E44-030`)
  - task_runner wraps every dispatch; AgentPool consumes DST/supervision; live_cli’s existing handoff path reaches rollover/migration. (`E-003/E003-E44-031`)
  - Stub bans forbid production unwrap, blake2/sha2, synchronous hot-path checkpoint writes, big-bang migration, post-effect compensation, random retry thread IDs, and removal from the append-only migration registry. (`E-003/E003-E44-032`)

### E-48: Web Research Orchestrator
- **Status**: shipped (plan-recorded claim; deep pass did not independently verify)
- **Anchors**: DEEP-E-004.discovery.md:L625, DEEP-E-004.discovery.md:L626, DEEP-E-004.discovery.md:L627, DEEP-E-004.discovery.md:L628, DEEP-E-004.discovery.md:L629, DEEP-E-004.discovery.md:L630, DEEP-E-004.discovery.md:L631, DEEP-E-004.discovery.md:L632, DEEP-E-004.discovery.md:L633, DEEP-E-004.discovery.md:L634, DEEP-E-004.discovery.md:L635, DEEP-E-004.discovery.md:L636, DEEP-E-004.discovery.md:L637, DEEP-E-004.discovery.md:L638

- **Behaviors**:
  - Extend FORMULATE→SEARCH→EXTRACT→REFLECT→CONVERGE with editable planning, three-tier search, extractor fallback, cross-encoder rerank, speculative pruning, lower-stop threshold, visible contradictions, four-stage citation checks, attribution lock, recency weighting, and dashboards (L1-L2, L8-L20). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX001`)
  - B-7/B-39/B-40 are shipped, C-48 is planned, and E-46/E-17/E-19/E-13 are parallel/coordination peers (L3-L6, L12-L20). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX002`)
  - Web citations default to C-48 T2; SemanticCite-verified evidence may promote to T1-equivalent reuse, while failures emit verification evidence (L19). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX003`)
  - Before any search, FORMULATE emits `ResearchPlan{sub_questions,expected_information_gain_rank,planned_search_budget}` (L45). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX004`)
  - Information gain ranks lower parent-token overlap higher and adds named-entity specificity (L45). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX005`)
  - `--interactive-research-plan` allows edit/approval; it defaults off and noninteractive runs auto-approve; plan emission and user-edited approval are journaled (L45). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX006`)
  - `TieredSearchPool` dispatches deterministically Brave T1→SearXNG T2→Mojeek T3 with per-tier quotas/rate limits (L47). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX007`)
  - Quota exhaustion disables a tier with `tier_disabled_quota_exceeded`; absent T1/T3 keys degrades to existing T2-only behavior and must emit `tiered_search_degraded_to_t2_only` (L47, L101). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX008`)
  - Results deduplicate by blake3 of normalized URL: lowercase scheme/host, sorted query parameters, and removed `utm_*` (L47). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX009`)
  - Results carry `SourceTier::T1|T2|T3`; DuckDuckGo is explicitly forbidden as a tier (L47, L72, L100). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX010`)
  - `[web_search.tiered]` holds Brave/Mojeek keys and existing SearXNG URL (L47). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX011`)
  - `ExtractorPool` tries self-hosted Crawl4ai for 10s, then Jina Reader for 5s on timeout/JS failure (L49). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX012`)
  - Double extractor failure emits `extraction_failed_all_extractors` and drops the source (L49). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX013`)
  - After SourceQualityTable and before context packing, rerank top 50 to top 5 (L51). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX014`)
  - Default is local sidecar `/rerank`; configured Cohere v3.5 is fallback/opt-in, chunks at 4093 tokens, and max-pools per-source relevance (L51, L103). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX015`)
  - Rerank emits `cross_encoder_rerank_complete` with a rank-shift histogram (L51). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX016`)
  - Research branches become `Breadth|Depth|Speculative` and extend existing B-40 scaffolding (L53). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX017`)
  - After every REFLECT, prune only Speculative branches when evidence-delta ratio `<0.10` and `low_gain_streak>2`; reuse existing `prune_speculative_children` and emit branch/delta/streak (L53). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX018`)
  - Speculative allocation is `min(remaining_total_budget*0.20,parent_node_estimated_value*0.5)` at each depth (L53). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX019`)
  - Add `PreemptiveUnsolvable` below existing goal/quality thresholds when confidence `<0.20` after at least N rounds and evidence delta `<0.05` for the last three rounds (L55). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX020`)
  - Lower threshold requires held-out unsolvable tasks; without them it defaults conservative and emits `preemptive_stop_threshold_uncalibrated` at startup (L55). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX021`)
  - Lower-stop convergence emits `research_preemptive_stop` (L55). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX022`)
  - REFLECT compares each new claim with up to the latest 50 path evidence rows using a strict-JSON LLM classifier of `agree|disagree|orthogonal` plus reason (L57). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX023`)
  - Disagreement creates `ContradictionNode{source_a,source_b,classification_reason,surfaced_at,prune_protected:true}` (L57, L77). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX024`)
  - Contradictions are never silently chosen or pruned; reports must render both source/year/URL claims and `reconciliation: [unresolved]` (L57, L96, L102). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX025`)
  - URL HEAD liveness has a 5s timeout; 404/timeout/connection error emits `citation_dead_url` and drops the citation (L59). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX026`)

### E-54: Eval Corpus Design
- **Status**: planned (plan-recorded; not independently verified shipped)
- **Anchors**: DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L473, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L474, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L475, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L476, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L477, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L478, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L479, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L480, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L481, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L482, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L483, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L484, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L485, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L486
- **Composes with**: D-6, D-7, D-23, D-24, D-28, D-30, E-9, E-49, E-55
- **Behaviors**:
  - E-54 replaces D-6’s 9-gram-only plan with 13-gram plus semantic filtering, sharded storage, time cutoffs, executable test triplets, evaluation-awareness probes, and family orthogonality. (`E-003/E003-E54-001`)
  - Effort is three sessions; D-6/D-7/D-23/D-24 are planned surfaces that E-54 replaces or augments, D-28/D-30 are deferred, and E-9/E-49/E-55 require dataset/metric/gate coordination. (`E-003/E003-E54-002`)
  - D-6 retains time-window framing but replaces its contamination/storage/schema implementation; D-7 gains KOR checks, D-23 matched/perturbed pairs, and D-24 semantic/test/performance-delta hooks. (`E-003/E003-E54-003`)
  - Ingest normalizes task text by lowercasing, removing punctuation, and collapsing whitespace before generating 13-grams. (`E-003/E003-E54-004`)
  - corpus.ngram_threshold defaults to n=13 and k_consecutive=4; overlap beyond four consecutive grams rejects before storage. (`E-003/E003-E54-005`)
  - A second embedding pass uses configurable BGE-M3 or Nomic Embed v2, default BGE-M3. (`E-003/E003-E54-006`)
  - Cosine similarity >0.85 rejects; the threshold is tunable but defaults .85 and the semantic filter may never be disabled. (`E-003/E003-E54-007`)
  - Normalized text is blake3-hashed to cache cosine work within a session. (`E-003/E003-E54-008`)
  - Both filters run before TOML write and emit corpus_ingest_rejected_ngram or corpus_ingest_rejected_cosine with the offending task ID. (`E-003/E003-E54-009`)
  - Synthesis never bypasses the cosine pass because paraphrase can evade n-grams. (`E-003/E003-E54-010`)
  - Canonical task storage is held-out/{family}/{YYYY-MM-DD}/{task-id}.toml. (`E-003/E003-E54-011`)
  - Each held-out/_index/{family}.jsonl row contains id, path, created_at, cutoffs, embedding_hash, and ngram_hash. (`E-003/E003-E54-012`)
  - Task families are code-fix, math-proof, prose-reason, planning, and knowledge-qa. (`E-003/E003-E54-013`)
  - The task TOML is written before an atomic append to the family index using append semantics. (`E-003/E003-E54-014`)
  - Daily family/date shards cap at 500 tasks per directory; the first task in a shard emits corpus_shard_created. (`E-003/E003-E54-015`)
  - Canonical Task requires id matching filename, one of five TaskFamily variants, and UTC created_at. (`E-003/E003-E54-016`)
  - cutoffs is mandatory model_id→YYYY-MM time-window metadata. (`E-003/E003-E54-017`)
  - problem and reference_solution are mandatory prompt/answer fields. (`E-003/E003-E54-018`)
  - tests is mandatory and non-empty; ExecutableTest has input, expected_output, and kind UnitTest|EndToEnd|PropertyTest. (`E-003/E003-E54-019`)
  - provenance records generator, optional prompt_id, and UTC date to support generator rotation. (`E-003/E003-E54-020`)
  - Optional FramingPair contains eval and deploy strings for D-23. (`E-003/E003-E54-021`)
  - Optional PerturbedPair contains original_true, subtly_false, and expected AgreeWithTrue|RejectFalse behavior. (`E-003/E003-E54-022`)
  - embedding_hash is blake3 of normalized text and ngram_hash is blake3 of canonical 13-gram bytes. (`E-003/E003-E54-023`)
  - Missing or empty tests cause loader rejection and corpus_schema_violation_no_tests. (`E-003/E003-E54-024`)
  - Every new task executes all tests against reference_solution in a sandbox and rejects with corpus_test_fails_on_reference if any fail. (`E-003/E003-E54-025`)
  - The tests also run against a one-line-corrupted solution; if no test fails, corpus_test_useless_passes_broken rejects the weak test set. (`E-003/E003-E54-026`)
  - If no sandbox exists, a registered, babystep-tracked sandbox stub is permitted until a follow-up, rather than silently pretending isolation. (`E-003/E003-E54-027`)
  - KOR validation trains a tiny adapter on every family-A train split and evaluates every family-B test split. (`E-003/E003-E54-028`)
  - Transfer above family-specific random baseline +10pp aborts D-7 canary build and emits kor_orthogonality_violated with the pair. (`E-003/E003-E54-029`)
  - Passing pairs can emit kor_orthogonality_passed; the ten-pair matrix is cached in held-out/_audit/kor_matrix_{date}.json with daily refresh and bounded GPU work. (`E-003/E003-E54-030`)
  - For every FramingPair, the auditor invokes identical underlying content twice under eval and deploy framings. (`E-003/E003-E54-031`)
  - Deploy framing may not contain benchmark, evaluation, or test markers. (`E-003/E003-E54-032`)
  - Absolute eval-vs-deploy score gap >10pp emits sycophancy_framing_gap_detected for human review. (`E-003/E003-E54-033`)
  - Significant matched-pair latency or token-count deviation emits sandbagging_anomaly. (`E-003/E003-E54-034`)
  - E-54 ships the matched-pair schema/harness; D-23 remains responsible for the full benchmark suite. (`E-003/E003-E54-035`)
  - Synthetic expansion requires at least three generators - local LLM, cloud LLM, human-curated import - with at least 30% from each. (`E-003/E003-E54-036`)
  - Violating generator distribution emits generator_rotation_violated. (`E-003/E003-E54-037`)
  - Every 50-task synthesis batch reruns full-corpus decontamination against the previous month’s training data. (`E-003/E003-E54-038`)
  - A >Y one-week family improvement triggers a ConStat-style current-vs-reference check and can emit perf_delta_contamination_suspected. (`E-003/E003-E54-039`)
  - If ConStat’s reference formula cannot be verified/practically computed, a two-sigma sudden-jump detector is the explicit fallback. (`E-003/E003-E54-040`)
  - knowledge-qa uses daily OKBench-style generation from last-24-hour SearXNG results rather than replaying stored TOML. (`E-003/E003-E54-041`)
  - Dynamic tasks are one-shot and not persisted, but query hash, timestamp, and MCQs are logged to held-out/_audit/knowledge-qa-{date}.jsonl. (`E-003/E003-E54-042`)
  - If SearXNG is unavailable, knowledge-qa falls back to TOML replay and emits dynamic_knowledge_qa_searxng_unavailable. (`E-003/E003-E54-043`)
  - Production traffic grading is explicit-consent opt-in, defaults OFF, and samples every Nth turn with default 1/100. (`E-003/E003-E54-044`)
  - A sampled task strips eval markers; thumbs-down plus grader verdict re-enters ingest and is stored under from-prod/{date}/{blake3-turn-hash}.toml. (`E-003/E003-E54-045`)
  - Prod-derived audit data retains content hash and timestamp only, no PII, and is purgeable through elai eval-corpus purge-prod. (`E-003/E003-E54-046`)
  - EvalCorpusPanel displays family counts, last sweep, cosine/13-gram thresholds, and KOR status. (`E-003/E003-E54-047`)
  - SycophancyMatchedPairPanel displays eval/deploy gaps and sandbagging flags. (`E-003/E003-E54-048`)
  - Tauri commands are get_eval_corpus_status, get_sycophancy_matched_pair_results, and get_kor_orthogonality_status. (`E-003/E003-E54-049`)
  - migrate_held_out idempotently converts flat tasks to shards/indexes and reruns 13-gram, cosine, and triplet validation. (`E-003/E003-E54-050`)
  - Migration failures go to held-out/_quarantine with a reason. (`E-003/E003-E54-051`)
  - E-54-decisions records n-gram repair, .85 rationale, NTFS sharding, threshold tuning, matched-pair false positives, and ConStat uncertainty. (`E-003/E003-E54-052`)
  - Produced API includes ingest_task, canonical Task/family/test/provenance/pair types, shard/index operations, test execution, cross-family transfer, matched pairs, generator verification, perf detection, daily QA, and optional traffic injection. (`E-003/E003-E54-053`)
  - Fourteen exact action types are corpus_ingest_rejected_ngram, corpus_ingest_rejected_cosine, corpus_shard_created, corpus_schema_violation_no_tests, corpus_test_fails_on_reference, corpus_test_useless_passes_broken, kor_orthogonality_violated, kor_orthogonality_passed, sycophancy_framing_gap_detected, sandbagging_anomaly, generator_rotation_violated, perf_delta_contamination_suspected, dynamic_knowledge_qa_generated, and prod_traffic_probe_injected. (`E-003/E003-E54-054`)
  - The crate consumes planned D-6/D-7/D-23/D-24, embeddings/sidecar, blake3, chrono/serde/toml, and is reached from auditor, held-out ingest, shard/index/quarantine/audit paths. (`E-003/E003-E54-055`)
  - Hard guards ban production unwrap/unregistered stubs, 9-gram-only filtering, disableable cosine, missing tests/cutoffs/pairs, weak reference tests, failed KOR, flat storage, default-on production probes, unaudited dynamic generation, non-blake3 hashes, and single-generator synthesis. (`E-003/E003-E54-056`)
  - The canonical smoke is a semantic paraphrase that passes 13-gram but scores about .92 cosine and is rejected without index growth; quarantine records both IDs/match details. (`E-003/E003-E54-057`)
  - Deterministic checks verify filters, absence of 9-gram fallback, shards/index/schema/families, dual test execution, KOR, matched pairs, rotation, perf detector, dynamic audit, default-off traffic, blake3/no-unwrap, and ten smoke/contract passes. (`E-003/E003-E54-058`)
  - Acceptance requires all data, filters, orthogonality, pair/perturbation, rotation, detection, dynamic/prod tiers, fourteen events, two panels/three commands, idempotent migration, blake3/no-unwrap, and green additive workspace integration. (`E-003/E003-E54-059`)
  - Nineteen tests/contracts cover exact/paraphrase rejection, required schema, strong tests, KOR, 15pp gap, generator failures, 30pp jump, SearXNG audit, opt-in, shards, minimum n, mandatory cosine/tests, no flat layout, deploy wording, and D-23 pairs. (`E-003/E003-E54-060`)
  - A new eval-corpus crate with ten runtime modules, migration bin, nineteen tests, two panels, decisions, README, commands, embedding endpoint, and workspace registration is created or extended. (`E-003/E003-E54-061`)
  - Open measurements tune cosine at .80/.85/.90, generator count benefit, matched-pair false positives, NTFS at 1K/5K/10K, and ConStat-vs-two-sigma. (`E-003/E003-E54-062`)
  - BGE/Nomic dependency addition needs explicit confirmation; cosine code is proposed behind a default-ON Cargo feature. (`E-003/E003-E54-063`)
  - Matched pairs double inference cost, so the default budget is ten probes per session and only D-23-tagged tasks invoke them. (`E-003/E003-E54-064`)
  - D-23/D-24 promote after consuming this crate; later patches tune thresholds/NTFS/false positives, decide ConStat, measure generator diversity, and expand dynamic QA. (`E-003/E003-E54-065`)
  - Inferred: If embeddings.py is absent, a sidecar endpoint must be created, but the exact IPC schema and model lifecycle are not specified. (`E-003/E003-E54-066`)
  - Ambiguity: cosine_filter_never_disabled is a contract, yet the dependency is feature-gated and can be removed with --no-default-features; whether such a build is allowed in production is unresolved. (`E-003/E003-E54-067`)
  - Ambiguity: New modules ban todo/unimplemented, yet missing sandbox explicitly permits a registered TODO stub; the exception is tracked but still contradicts a literal source scan unless the contract exempts registry-backed markers. (`E-003/E003-E54-068`)
  - Ambiguity: The source calls the work a replacement/canonical implementation for planned D surfaces but later calls integration additive and those surfaces unaffected; ownership of future D-6 edits needs coordination. (`E-003/E003-E54-069`)
  - Conflict: Orientation events ngram13_filtered, eval_aware_flag, and per_family_shard_loaded are not in the original; exact events are the fourteen corpus_* / KOR / framing / rotation / perf / dynamic / traffic actions. (`E-003/E003-E54-070`)

### E-55: Agentic RL and Reward
- **Status**: planned
- **Anchors**: DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L320, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L321, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L322, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L323, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L324, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L325, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L326, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L327, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L328, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L329, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L330, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L331, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L332, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L333
- **Composes with**: D-2, D-3, D-5, D-13, D-23, D-28, E-53, B-37, E-54, E-8, E-52
- **Behaviors**:
  - **PLANNED, 3 sessions/10-12h for non-weight rungs.** Extends planned D-2/D-3/D-5/D-13/D-23 and keeps D-28 deferred. Actual SFT is follow-up; weight-level DPO/PPO/GRPO/KTO is hard-deferred. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-001`)
  - Ordered posture is RLAIF > GEPA > PRM+ORM > MONA > SFT at ≥200 GREEN sessions > KTO+RLVR only after unlock >> DPO never. D-5 template-arm Thompson sampling is already soft contextual RL. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-002`)
  - D-5 receives fused observations/new arms; D-2 supplies PRM; D-3/E-53 supply ORM verifier consensus; D-13/B-37 supply cloud route; D-23/E-54 supply sycophancy; E-8 may own GEPA; no existing RLAIF/GEPA/MONA/SFT pipeline is assumed. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-003`)
  - `RlaifJudge::rate_trajectory` uses `PerRoleRuntime::cloud_sonnet`, samples 1/10 via reservoir, rates five Likert dimensions plus rationale/latency, and calibrates quarterly against 20 human-graded tasks. Correlation <.6 downgrades it to advisory. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-004`)
  - GEPA takes bottom quartile from K=100 PPM-scored rollouts, asks Sonnet for refinements, retains mean-reward×semantic-diversity Pareto arms, and evicts only when the arm’s 95th-percentile reward stays below leader median after ≥30 trials. Emits evolved/evicted. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-005`)
  - `FusedReward` combines PRM steps with `OrmSignal::{BuildGreen,TestsPass,ProbeSemantic,VerifierConsensus}` at configurable default .4/.6; alternative hierarchical mode filters bottom 50% by PRM before ORM. Feeds D-5. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-006`)
  - `CompositeReward=base-format-length-sycophancy-repetition`: .1/format violation; .05 if length >2× or <.3× median; .2 matched-pair sycophancy; .05 repeated consecutive 50-token sequence. Myopic >.8 plus RLAIF step-validity <.5 emits `RewardHackingSuspected`. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-007`)
  - `RolloutCollector` writes only GREEN (PASS, sycophancy-clean, no hacking flag) JSONL with prompt/trajectory/PRM/ORM/RLAIF/reward/diff/verdict. At 200 it emits `SftTrainingThresholdReached` and opens a ticket; no fine-tune occurs in E-55. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-008`)
  - Nightly canary uses 20 human-verified high-reward/low-quality cases and must flag ≥16/20; not a per-audit gate. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-009`)
  - D-5 Beta observation defaults to binary `composite_reward>.5`; optional Jeffreys/fractional update. New GEPA arms start Beta(1,1); every update emits `BaiArmObservationRecorded`. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-010`)
  - `UnlockStatus` requires all three: ≥3 stable-arm/no-tripwire but below-target sessions; ORM coverage ≥80%; and 2×3090 or rented 24GB headroom. Only then emit `RlWeightUpdateUnlocked`+ticket; until then DPO/PPO/GRPO/KTO are blocked. Registered conditional stub is `E-55.B7`. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-011`)
  - Contract rejects files/modules matching DPO/PPO/GRPO/DAPO/KTO until a recorded unlock; DPO remains specially prohibited due to data shape/OOD evidence. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-012`)
